description: Looks up a file hash (SHA-256, SHA-1 or MD5) in abuse.ch MalwareBazaar: whether the sample is known, its other hashes, file name, type, size, signature (malware family), first/last seen, reporter, origin country, delivery method, tags, download count and code-signing info. Metadata only; the sample itself is never downloaded. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

hash.description: SHA-256 (64 hex), SHA-1 (40 hex) or MD5 (32 hex) of the file (required)
